title: CLI latin-1 fallback behaviour not pinned in test suite
summary: src/crc10_gsm/__main__.py:36 falls back to v.encode('latin-1') when hex/decimal parsing fails. --data ZZZZ silently produces [0x5A, 0x5A, 0x5A, 0x5A] and exits 0. This is documented behaviour (not a vulnerability), but no test asserts the latin-1 fallback output value. A future refactor could silently change this behaviour.

title: No >=1 MB stress test asserting bounded compute time
summary: The longest input tested in tests/ is 1 MiB. TEST_GAPS gaps #1/#2/#3 document that 100 MiB and 200 MiB inputs were verified live (22.84s, 36.94s, 76.2s respectively — all linear O(n)), but no unit test pins the large-input bound. CWE-400 is empirically bounded but not locked in the test suite.

title: No stdin binary-variant test (CRLF, binary bytes, empty)
summary: TEST_GAPS gaps #4/#5/#13/#16 document that CRLF-terminated, binary-byte, and empty stdin variants were verified live with --stdin, but no test in the suite asserts these variants. The current test_cli_stdin only covers the canonical RevEng vector b'123456789'. Binary-stdin contract is empirically verified but not pinned.

title: No concurrent thread-safety test
summary: Implementation has no shared mutable state, but no test asserts thread-safety. A ThreadPoolExecutor-based test would lock the invariant. TEST_GAPS gaps #14/#15 note re-entrancy and thread-safety are not covered in the suite.

title: CLI _parse_data silent & 0xFF masking not pinned in tests
summary: TEST_GAPS gaps #17/#18/#19 document that int('-1') & 0xFF = 0xFF, -0x10 & 0xFF = 0xF0, and 0x100 & 0xFF = 0x00 are all silently truncated by & 0xFF masking in __main__.py:28,31,34. No test pins this masking behaviour. A future refactor that removes the mask could silently change outputs.
